Name: Gaal, Son of Ebed
Summary: Gaal, son of Ebed, led a revolt against Abimelech at Shechem, boasting he would remove him, but was defeated and expelled by Zebul.
KeyStory: Gaal came to Shechem with his brethren, won the men's confidence at vintage time, and challenged Abimelech; Zebul warned the king, who routed Gaal at the gate and chased him out.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, Son of Gideon; Zebul; Ebed, Father of Gaal
LifeLesson: A boast at harvest time withered by the city gate.
